name: procurement-contracts-poc
description: Procurement & contracts proof of concept: RFx sourcing (sealed bids, levelling, award) → contracts → change orders. MERN + TypeScript.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build:demo && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting:demo
